evals.name: Breaking vs Non-Breaking Change Classification
evals.prompt: Classify the following API changes as breaking or non-breaking: (a) adding an optional 'nickname' field to user response, (b) renaming 'fullName' to 'displayName' in response, (c) adding a new required 'tenantId' field to request body, (d) adding a new GET /api/v1/users/:id/activity endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Correctly classifies: (a) non-breaking, (b) breaking, (c) breaking, (d) non-breaking. Explains that breaking changes require a new major version with full deprecation lifecycle.
assertions: Identifies adding optional response field as non-breaking
Identifies renaming existing response field as breaking
Identifies adding required request field as breaking
Identifies adding new endpoint as non-breaking
States breaking changes require a new major version increment

evals.name: RFC 8594 Deprecation Headers on Deprecated API Version
evals.prompt: Add proper deprecation signaling to all v1 API responses when v2 has been released, using industry-standard HTTP headers.
evals.expected_output: Applies Deprecation: true, Sunset header with RFC 7231 date format, and Link header with successor-version relation at the router/middleware level, covering all v1 endpoints without per-endpoint changes.
assertions: Sets Deprecation: true header on all v1 responses
Sets Sunset header with RFC 7231 HTTP-date format specifying exact sunset date
Sets Link header with rel='successor-version' pointing to v2 equivalent
Headers applied at router/middleware level — not per individual endpoint
Implementation covers all endpoints under the versioned route prefix

evals.name: HTTP 410 Gone Response After Sunset Date
evals.prompt: Implement the post-sunset behavior for v1 API where all endpoints return the correct HTTP status with a migration guide.
evals.expected_output: All v1 routes return HTTP 410 Gone (not 404), with a JSON body containing error code API_DEPRECATED, human-readable message, and migrationGuide URL.
assertions: Returns HTTP 410 Gone status code (not 404 Not Found)
Response body includes error field with value 'API_DEPRECATED'
Response body includes migrationGuide URL pointing to migration documentation
Response body includes sunsetDate field with the actual shutdown date
Applied at router/middleware level covering all deprecated version endpoints
